Upcoming Royal Events

 

We will be updating this page as we receive information about upcoming royal events, so periodically check this page. Important events in home countries and foreign countries will be listed. Birthdays and wedding anniversaries will not be listed here unless they are milestones and official celebrations are planned. Information on births, anniversaries, and deaths can be seen in the daily Today in Royal History. National Days and public holidays related to royalty will also be listed, as members of royal families often make appearances on those days. Information on historical ceremonies and events, and royal ceremonies and events held throughout the year can be seen at Royal Ceremonies and Events.

While we focus on foreign events and important national events, members of royal families carry out many other engagements. Below is a selection of links listing engagements. Because a more complete listing of events is often found in the language of particular monarchies, some links are not in English and are noted.

United Kingdom – British Monarchy: The Royal Diary – The Royal Diary has not been listing future engagements for The Prince of Wales and The Princess of Wales for quite a while. The Prince of Wales’s official website, which listed engagements for The King and The Queen when they were The Prince of Wales and The Duchess of Cornwall, has disappeared.
Belgium – De Belgische Monarchie: Agenda (in Dutch)
Denmark – Kongehuset: Kalendar (in Danish)
Luxembourg – Cour Grand-Ducale de Luxembourg: Agenda (in French)
Netherlands – Het Koninklijk Huis: Agenda (in Dutch)
Norway – Royal House of Norway: Official Engagements
Spain – Casa de Su Majestad El Rey: Scheduled Agenda (in Spanish)
Sweden – Sveriges Kungahus – Kungahusets Kalendar (in Swedish)

*******************

May 2026

May 17 – Norway – Constitution Day, the National Day of Norway, the Norwegian Royal Family makes an appearance on the balcony of the Royal Palace in Oslo.
May 18 – United Kingdom – The Princess Royal, The Duke of Gloucester, and The Duchess of Gloucester will visit the Chelsea Flower Show of the Royal Horticultural Society in the Gardens of the Royal Hospital, Chelsea.
May 18 – 23 –  United Kingdom – Chelsea Flower Show – Members of the British Royal Family will attend The Chelsea Flower Show, sponsored by the Royal Horticultural Society and held on the grounds of the Royal Hospital Chelsea, an Old Soldiers’ retirement home and nursing home in Chelsea, London.
May 19 – United Kingdom – The Princess Royal, Patron, The Not Forgotten Association, will hold a Garden Party at Buckingham Palace.
Late Spring/Early Summer <dates to be determined> – United Kingdom – The British Royal Family will host Garden Parties at Buckingham Palace and Holyrood Palace

JUNE 2026

June 6 – Sweden – National Day of Sweden in honor of two historical events: Gustav Vasa‘s election as king (June 6, 1523) and the adoption of a new constitution (June 6, 1809). Members of the Swedish Royal Family make appearances. For detailed information, see Unofficial Royalty: National Day of Sweden.
June 9 – 11 – Netherlands – At the invitation of King Willem-Alexander, the Federal President of Germany, Frank-Walter Steinmeier, will pay a state visit to the Netherlands, accompanied by his wife Elke Büdenbender.
June 13 – United Kingdom – King Charles III, accompanied by members of the Royal Family, will take the Salute at The King’s Birthday Parade (Trooping the Colour) on Horse Guards at Whitehall, London, and will witness a Fly-past by the Royal Air Force from the balcony at Buckingham Palace. For detailed information, see Unofficial Royalty: Trooping the Colour
 June 15 – United Kingdom – Garter Day: Members of The Most Noble Order of the Garter will participate in investing any new Companions, a procession, and a service at Windsor Castle. For more information, see Unofficial Royalty: Garter Day.
June 16 – 20 – United Kingdom – Royal Ascot – Royal Ascot: Members of the British royal family will attend Royal Ascot, a five-day race meeting held at Ascot Racecourse located in Ascot, Berkshire, England, 6 miles/9.7 km from Windsor Castle. For detailed information, see Unofficial Royalty: Royal Ascot.
June 23 – Luxembourg – Grand Duke Guillaume V‘s Official Birthday/Luxembourgish National Day

JULY 2026

July 17 – Lesotho – King’s Birthday, a public holiday celebrating the birth of King Letsie III, the current king.
July 21 – Belgium – Belgian National Day commemorates the events of  July 21, 1831, when Prince Leopold of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld swore allegiance to the new Belgian constitution and became the new nation’s first monarch, King Leopold I. The Belgian Royal Family makes appearances.

AUGUST 2026

August 15 – Liechtenstein – Liechtenstein National Day celebrates the Roman Catholic Feast of the Assumption and the Reigning Prince’s birthday.  The Princely Family of Liechtenstein makes appearances.

SEPTEMBER 2026

Second Tuesday of September – Sweden – Opening of the Parliamentary Session, King Carl XVI Gustaf delivers a short speech that includes topics he thinks are important for the upcoming parliamentary year and declares the new session open.
Third Tuesday of September  – Netherlands – Prinsjesdag (Prince’s Day), the third Tuesday of every September, King Willem-Alexander addresses a joint session of the Dutch Senate and House of Representatives to give the speech from the throne, setting out the main features of government policy for the upcoming parliamentary session.
September 23 – Saudi Arabia – National Day of Saudi Arabia

OCTOBER 2026

October 12 – Spain – National Day of Spain (Fiesta Nacional de España), the Spanish Royal Family makes appearances.

NOVEMBER 2026

November 4 – Tonga – Constitution Day/Tonga National Day
November 9 – United Kingdom – Remembrance Sunday – Members of the British Royal Family will attend the National Service of Remembrance at the Cenotaph in London. It is held on the second Sunday in November, the Sunday nearest to November 11, Armistice Day, the anniversary of the end of hostilities in the First World War.
November 11 – Belgium – On Armistice Day of Remembrance, King Philippe will participate in the military ceremony at the Congress Column, in honor of the Unknown Soldier, the fallen of the two world wars, and the soldiers who have died during humanitarian and peacekeeping missions since 1945.
November 15 – Belgium – King’s Day
November 18 – Morocco – Independence Day (Eid Al Istiqulal) Morocco’s National Day
November or December – United Kingdom – Diplomatic Reception – Members of the British Royal Family will attend the Diplomatic Reception at Buckingham Palace, honoring the foreign missions accredited to the Court of St James’s in London
November 19 – Monaco – The Sovereign Prince’s Day, Monaco National Day; the Princely Family of Monaco makes appearances.

DECEMBER 2026

(Note: Dates for the Norwegian and Swedish events can and probably will change.)

December 8 – Sweden – King Carl XVI Gustaf and Queen Silvia will attend the Nobel Prize Concert at the Stockholm Concert Hall
December 10 – Norway – Members of the Norwegian Royal Family will attend the Nobel Peace Prize Award Ceremony at Oslo City Hall.
December 10 – Norway – Members of the Norwegian Royal Family will attend a banquet in honor of the Nobel Peace Prize Laureates at the Grand Hotel in Oslo.
December 10 – Sweden – Members of the Swedish Royal Family will attend the presentation of the Nobel Prizes at the Stockholm Concert Hall in Stockholm, Sweden.
December 10 – Sweden – Members of the Swedish Royal Family will attend the Nobel Prize Banquet at the Stockholm City Hall in Stockholm, Sweden.
December 11 – Sweden –  Members of the Swedish Royal Family will attend The King’s Dinner for the Nobel Laureates.
December 16 – Bahrain – National Day of Bahrain, marking the accession of Isa bin Salman Al Khalifa, the first Emir of Bahrain.
December 17 – Bhutan – National Day of Bhutan, marking the coronation of Ugyen Wangchuck as the first Dragon King of modern Bhutan. The current Dragon King, Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck, gives a speech.
December 18 – Qatar – Qatar National Day commemorates the assumption of power by Emir Jassim bin Mohammed Al Thani in 1878.
December 25 – United Kingdom – King Charles III‘s Christmas Message will be broadcast at 3 PM London time, 10 AM US Eastern time.
December 31 – Denmark – King Frederik X will deliver the annual New Year’s Address from Fredensborg Palace.

JANUARY 2027

January – Denmark – Unofficial Royalty: New Year’s Events
January 1 – Denmark – The Danish royal family will attend the New Year’s banquet and banquets for the Government, the Speaker of the Danish Parliament, Representatives of official Denmark, and the Royal Court at Christian VII’s Palace in Copenhagen, Denmark
January 5 – Denmark – The King and Queen hold a New Year’s reception for Supreme Court judges, the Royal Life Guards, and the Guard Hussar Regiment’s Officer Corps. Christian VII’s Palace, Amalienborg, at 9.30 a.m.
January 5 – Denmark – The King and Queen hold a New Year’s reception for mayors and regional council chairmen. Christian VIII’s Palace, Amalienborg, at 10.30 a.m.
January 5 – Denmark – The King and Queen hold a New Year’s reception for the diplomatic corps. Christiansborg Palace, at 14.00.
January 6 – Denmark – The King and Queen hold New Year’s Eve banquets for officers from the Armed Forces and the Danish Emergency Management Agency, the Danish public sector, and selected groups with titles of nobility and honours, etc., as well as national organizations, etc., and patronages. Christiansborg Palace, 9.30 a.m.
January 6 – Spain – Pascua Militar marks the beginning of the military year and the Epiphany, a religious and national holiday

FEBRUARY 2027

February 17 (on or around) – Belgium – Commemoration for Deceased Members of the Belgian Royal Family
February 23 – Brunei – Brunei National Day, Hassanal Bolkiah, Sultan of Brunei, and his family make appearances.
February 23 – Japan – The Emperor’s Birthday, a national holiday celebrated on the birthday of the reigning Emperor, currently Emperor Naruhito.

MARCH 2027

March 10 – United Kingdom –  Commonwealth Day

APRIL 2027

April 27 – Netherlands – King’s Day – King Willem-Alexander will attend the celebration of King’s Day with members of the Royal Family. King’s Day (Koningsdag in Dutch) is a national holiday, marking the birth of King Willem-Alexander on April 27, 1967. It is celebrated on April 27 or April 26 if April 27 is a Sunday.

MAY 2027

May 4 – 5 – Netherlands – National Commemoration and Celebration of the Liberation (after World War II)
May 13 – Cambodia – King Sihamoni‘s Birthday, a National Holiday.
May 17 – Norway – Constitution Day, the National Day of Norway, the Norwegian Royal Family makes an appearance on the balcony of the Royal Palace in Oslo.
May 18 – 23 –  United Kingdom – Chelsea Flower Show – Members of the British Royal Family will attend The Chelsea Flower Show, sponsored by the Royal Horticultural Society and held on the grounds of the Royal Hospital Chelsea, an Old Soldiers’ retirement home and nursing home in Chelsea, London.
Late Spring/Early Summer <dates to be determined> – United Kingdom – The British Royal Family will host Garden Parties at Buckingham Palace and Holyrood Palace
